issue.title: Retire ace_unified_agents
issue.description: Show one unified Agents list across local and enrolled machines.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Remove this flag after the unified list, attention inbox, actions, launch experience, Machines pane, and live acceptance phases land with both-state coverage.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: ACE keeps the existing Focus and Fleet sub-tab experience unchanged.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: ACE shows one Agents list that includes local and enrolled-machine rows through the shared projection, with machine identity shown as row context.
